authorship.caveat: answerable queries were written with the page text in view (not blind); a human domain review has not been done; per-page n is 5-14, so every rate has a wide interval
authorship.fresh_check: no exact/near duplicate (Jaccard<0.8) of any Phase 4/5/7F/8 query; no query shares more than 3 contiguous words with any card text

preregistered.router: rank-1 of the card router, dense only, no similarity threshold (Phase 7F: min_cosine stays None)
preregistered.hit_definition: a retrieved chunk whose text contains (whitespace-normalised) any evidence quote of the query
preregistered.answer_correct_definition: status == answered AND at least one cited chunk contains an evidence quote AND the cited page is the gold page
preregistered.router_correct_definition: gold card at rank 1; for sibling_ambiguous / not_ingested queries rank-1 inside acceptable_source_ids is reported separately (never merged into the headline)
preregistered.hybrid_or_rerank_decision_rule: NOT tested unless the failure analysis names a concrete cause; if tested, adopt only if recall@1 on this set improves AND no facet drops by more than 5 points
